# How the Clacton by-election count will take place
Share

[Add as preferred on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=bbc.com)

![Reuters Clacton Pier with the big wheel.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/643d/live/d25365b0-9635-11f1-acde-358da1a6646b.jpg.webp)Reuters

The biggest British election campaign, in terms of the number of individuals standing for a single parliamentary seat, is nearly over.

![An election count with a table and people behind it sorting ballot papers into piles.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/c090/live/e6e36a60-9636-11f1-acde-358da1a6646b.jpg.webp)

- the [most candidates](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyem5lg78qo) in one British election

Of those, 10,716 have already received a postal vote.

In 2024, the general election result for Clacton was announced at about 04:00, but there were only nine candidates then.
